sxablono.name: redaktilo
sxablono.description: An editor with its preview: the source in a tekstareo of kind code beside its preview in a markdovido, side by side where there is room, one below the other where there is none; the preview follows every input and is no live region.

props.name: preview-label
props.description: The name of the preview, a region (Vorschau): heard, so a person knows what the text beside the field is.

regions.name: field
regions.description: The source: a tekstareo of kind code with its label, help and error.

regions.name: preview
regions.description: The preview: a markdovido that shows the source as it is typed, without announcing every key.

goals.kialo: Writing with a preview is one pattern, because the field and the preview are one task; the preview speaks only when the person goes there.
